showcase.welcome.prompt: You look like you have something to say...
showcase.welcome.resume: You were telling me about settling in...
showcase.welcome.hello: You know, I still remember when this village barely had a roof worth trusting.
showcase.welcome.hope: There are more people now, but I wonder if it feels like home to everyone.
showcase.welcome.happy: It feels like home to me.
showcase.welcome.learning: I'm still getting to know this place.
showcase.welcome.warm: Then perhaps we're doing something right.
showcase.welcome.warm_end: I hope we can keep it that way.
showcase.welcome.honest: That's fair. It took me a long time to settle in, too.
showcase.welcome.honest_end: If you ever want a story about this place, ask me.
showcase.bridge.resume: We hadn't finished talking about the old bridge...
showcase.bridge.opening: There's a ruined bridge beyond the fields. Most people only see rotten planks.
showcase.bridge.explanation: My family used to cross it every market day. I still remember the sound of the boards under their feet.
showcase.bridge.question: Sometimes I think I'm the only person who remembers it that way. Does that sound foolish?
showcase.bridge.listen: No. Tell me what those days were like.
showcase.bridge.dismiss: It's just a bridge. You should move on.
showcase.bridge.listening_reply: We'd leave before sunrise and bring home bread still warm from the baker.
showcase.bridge.listening_end: Thanks for listening. I don't get to share that memory very often.
showcase.bridge.ask_reply: A storm took out the supports. Nobody was hurt, thankfully, but no one ever rebuilt it.
showcase.bridge.ask_end: I suppose places can disappear even when their stories don't.
showcase.bridge.dismiss_reply: Maybe you're right. I didn't mean to waste your time.
showcase.bridge.dismiss_end: I think I'd rather be alone for a while.
showcase.followup.resume: You were about to tell me about the bridge...
showcase.followup.remember: Remember when you asked me about the old market days? I've been thinking about that.
showcase.followup.invitation: I've been sketching what the bridge looked like. Would you like to see it sometime?
showcase.followup.help: I'd like that. Tell me more.
showcase.followup.helpful: I'm glad. It feels good knowing someone else cares.
showcase.followup.later_reply: Of course. The memories aren't going anywhere.
showcase.night.resume: We were looking up at the sky...
showcase.night.opening: Have you noticed how quiet the village gets when the last window goes dark?
showcase.night.thought: It's strange. I can barely see the stars during the day, but that doesn't mean they've vanished.
showcase.night.stars: Maybe some things are still there even when we can't see them.
showcase.night.sleep: You should probably get some sleep.
showcase.night.stars_reply: I like that thought. I'll remember it on the next cloudy night.
showcase.night.sleep_reply: You're right. I get carried away thinking sometimes.
showcase.trust.resume: You were asking what I value...
showcase.trust.open: We know each other better now. Can I tell you something?
showcase.trust.question: I don't need everyone to agree with me. I just want to feel heard, especially when I'm worried.
showcase.trust.heard: That's all I could ask. Thank you.
showcase.trust.understood: Nobody always understands. Being willing to try matters more.
showcase.ambient.work.resume: You were telling me about your work...
showcase.ambient.work.open: I passed the workshop earlier. Someone's been fixing the roof one plank at a time.
showcase.ambient.work.end: Funny how a little bit of effort can make a place feel cared for.
showcase.ambient.home.resume: You were telling me what makes a home...
showcase.ambient.home.open: Every village has its noises: doors closing, people calling, footsteps on stone.
showcase.ambient.home.end: I used to find it distracting. Now I'd miss it if it went quiet.
